title: Duplicate bug in module-level select_channel function
description:
File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:250

Standalone select_channel function has identical off-by-one bug as the method.

**Failure scenario:** Same as line 88 - for 8-channel plans, when hash % num_channels equals 7, returns num_channels (8) which is out of bounds. The fix should use 'n = max(plan.num_channels - 1, 2)' to match the correct implementation in link/channel.py.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
notes: Not a defect at HEAD. Verified with independent FNV-1a32 oracle recomputed from spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md 2a.3 pseudocode (N=MAX(NChannels,3); Channel=1+(H MOD N); channels 1..N, CH0 reserved control): all 10 vectors in ccp_select_channel_endianness.json reproduced by hand-math AND by both channel_plan.select_channel forms; 5000-epoch sweep on EU868 gives outputs [1,8], every value resolves via EU868.frequency(ch-1) - returning num_channels is a VALID 1-based data channel, no out-of-bounds exists. Vector file itself mandates max(n,3) NOT max(n,3)-1. Bead's cited reference link/channel.py uses max(n_channels-1,1) (different CCP-9 algorithm incl. SFN in hash), not the prescribed max(num_channels-1,2); applying that fix would break spec conformance, ccp.py parity, and 172 passing vector tests.
close_reason: already fixed/not-a-bug at HEAD: both select_channel copies already implement the correct normative formula n=max(num_channels,3); return 1+(h%n) per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:198, appendix-ccp12-hopping.md:85 (channels 1..N, CH0 reserved), and ccp_select_channel_endianness.json which mandates max(n_channels,3) NOT -1 with output [1,n] inclusive. Verified via independent from-scratch FNV-1a32 oracle (all 10 endianness vectors match), method==function==spec-oracle over 200 epochs, 5000-epoch EU868 sweep outputs [1,8] all valid through plan.frequency(). Suites green: test_channel_plan+test_ccp 90 passed, test_vectors ccp16/endianness/load slice 82 passed; ruff clean on channel_plan.py. The 4 pre-existing ruff findings are in foreign untracked test files test_ccp.py/test_channel_plan.py and were left untouched per scope guard.
